name: Press Advantage
description:
Trigger: You win an engagement.

Your opponent takes –1 Defense. This penalty is cumulative and lasts for the duration of the combat, provided you remain focused on that creature.

At the end of each round, the effect persists if you did not attack a different creature and at least one of the following is true:

  • You entered engagement with the creature.

  • You dealt damage to the creature.

  • You used all your movement to move closer to the creature and ended within Short Range of it.

If these conditions are not met, all penalties from this ability immediately end.

Describe how you bear down on your opponent.
